candidates.name: Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art
candidates.alt: MAMAC, Musée d'art moderne et d'art contemporain de Nice
candidates.hours: May-Oct: Tue-Sun 10:00-18:00; Nov-Apr: Tue-Sun 11:00-18:00; closed Jan 1, May 1, Dec 25
candidates.content: It has four connected towers featuring modern and contemporary artists and their sculptures, paintings, and conceptual installations. Its open-air roof terraces offer one of the best panoramas of the city.

candidates.name: Chateâu de Bellet
candidates.content: Château de Bellet has a winery, vineyards and wine tastings in a deconsecrated chapel. The wine cellar, built in 2015, is partially underground and semi-circular in shape, conceived for the reception of the grape by gravity and th

candidates.name: Musée Marc Chagall
candidates.price: Full rate €8, reduced rate €6, free for students below 26 and for everybody every first Sunday of the month
candidates.hours: May-Oct: 10:00-18:00; Nov-Apr: Wed-Mon 10:00-17:00; closed on Tue and on Jan 1, May 1, Dec 25
candidates.content: Even if you are not in art, this is a museum which should not be missed. It includes stained glass windows by the artist.

candidates.name: Musée des Beaux-Arts Jules Chéret
candidates.hours: May-Oct: Tue-Sun 10:00-18:00; Nov-Apr: Tue-Sun 11:00-18:00; closed Jan 1, Easter May 1, Dec 25
candidates.content: To the west, there is the Musée des Beaux-Arts, housing an excellent collection of pastels and other works by Jules Cheret, among other artists.

candidates.name: Musée d’Archéologie de Nice
candidates.hours: May-Oct 10:00-18:00; Nov-Apr 10:00-17:00; closed Tue and major holidays
candidates.content: The ruins of the Gallo-Roman settlement in Cimiez, plus a museum with nice documentation on Gallo-Roman life (but mostly not in English). Activities for children. Guided tours available.

candidates.name: Colline du Château
candidates.content: The castle hill overlooking the Baie des Anges and harbour offers a spectacular vantage point overlooking the city. Not much is left of its ruined castle besides crumbling walls. Still, climbing up the stairs to reach the platform

candidates.name: Musée des Arts Asiatiques
candidates.price: Free visit, conference, Qi Gong and Tai Chi Chuan
candidates.hours: Jul Aug: Wed-Mon 10:00-18:00; Sep-Jun: Wed-Mon 10:00-17:00; closed Jan 1, May 1 and Dec 25
candidates.content: Indian, Chinese, Southeast Asian, and world art in great architecture on a lake.

candidates.name: Musée Matisse
candidates.content: Charming collection of paintings, drawings and sculptures in 17th-century Genoese villa.

candidates.name: Parc Phoenix
candidates.content: 2500 different plants in botanical garden and tropical glass house. Also various animals.

candidates.name: Train des Pignes
candidates.price: Nice – Puget-Théniers – Entrevaux round trip: adult €37.4, child (up to 11 years old) €24.8; Nice – Puget-Théniers – Annot – round trip: adult €40.4, child €26.8; Nice – Puget-Théniers – Le Fugeret round trip: adult €48.4, child €33.8
candidates.content: A regular SNCF train departs from Nice to Puget-Théniers, where it connects to a narrow-gauge railway through the mountains and valleys of the hinterland. A very scenic but less comfortable ride than the SNCF main lines. Terminate

candidates.name: Cliff Walk
candidates.content: You can follow the path around Cap de Nice half way to Villefranche, but be prepared for several hundred steps up to rejoin the road. It’s a very beautiful walk and you will find mostly local people using it.

candidates.name: Opéra Nice Côte d'Azur
candidates.content: This opera house hosts not only opera performances but also many concerts of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Nice and chamber music recitals, and some ballet performances. The house's website is in French only, but even if you don

candidates.name: Ma Nolan's
candidates.content: Right in the heart of the 'Old Town' and next to the opera, Ma Nolan's has everything you would expect from an Irish pub: live music every night, major sporting events on four screens, really good food and very friendly staff.

candidates.name: Akathor Pub

candidates.name: Wayne's

candidates.name: L’Essenciel Bar Panoramique
candidates.content: Lounge bar at the pool on top of the hotel. Relaxed atmosphere and great views over the city.

candidates.name: Le Blue Whales
candidates.content: Created in 1993. Rock ambiance for young folks. Live music, live sports and Trivia Night entertainment Wednesdays at 20h00. The restaurant offers typical pub grub and a few salads.

candidates.name: le Delhi Belhi
candidates.price: €15-20 per person (alcoholic drinks and wine are extra)

candidates.name: Le Lavomatique
candidates.content: The former small lauderette or laundry shop is transformed in to a modern bistro and hosted by two brothers who are passionate about bistronomy. The chefs offer fresh, local ingredients listed in a seasonal menu in a French tapas

candidates.name: Peixes

candidates.name: Jan

candidates.name: Le Plongeoir
candidates.hours: Lunch and dinner (closed Tue evening and Wed)
candidates.content: Le Plongeoir is perched high above the sea on a famous pillar of rock overlooking the port of Nice and offering a stunning and memorable view. Platform diving boards (hence the name) pre-date the restaurant. The menu features fres

candidates.name: Lou Pilha Leva

candidates.name: Le Lodge
candidates.content: If you're watching your budget but want to have a gourmet, healthy meal, this is the place to go for lunch. For €11 you get a main course, a drink such as wine, beer or soda and after the meal, a coffee. Try the trio of fish. For

candidates.name: Fennocchio's
candidates.hours: Mar-Nov: daily 10:00-12:00 (one store closed on Tue)
candidates.content: Serves ice creams and Italian-style ices. It's a tough choice to select just one or two of the 94 flavours, which include classics like chocolate or vanilla and less usual ones like thyme, cactus or lavender. 2 locations in the Ol

candidates.sec: In the city centre around the tram stop Masséna
candidates.name: chez alex
candidates.content: Hidden gem in Nice! It kept this traditional French bistrot atmosphere. The staff is genuine and welcoming. The food is delicious.

candidates.sec: In the city centre around the tram stop Masséna
candidates.name: 7 Days
candidates.content: Amazing local pizza and lovely owner. The pizzas are amazing, very tasty and good size.

candidates.name: Terres de Truffes
candidates.price: €8 for takeout up to €42 for a restaurant main plate
candidates.content: Takeout, delivery or eat-in bistro where you can taste all varieties of truffles paired with food and wine. Takeout includes small bottles of truffle oil.

candidates.name: Le Chantecler
candidates.content: The Chantecler is a two-star Michelin restaurant and a destination of many gourmets and foodies. Extraordinary gastronomy by Master Chef Virginie Basselot mixes lightness and complexity with renowned table service. The menu offers

candidates.name: Flower Market
candidates.content: Originally a 19th-century flower market, this street market is now full of produce and baked goods, and some souvenirs.

candidates.name: Marché aux Fruits et Legumes
candidates.content: Food market.
